_comment: Verified public-domain nursery rhymes and kids-content sources. A title may be used ONLY if pd_verified is true. Adding or flipping a row is a compliance decision: verify against a citable printed source, then log it in audit/decision_log.csv.
verification_standard: First publication in print before 1930 (95-year term under 17 U.S.C. 304 expired), verified against a citable printed source. As of 2026 the line is 1930; it advances one year each January 1.

content_types.rhyme: Classic nursery rhyme set to our own recording
content_types.lullaby: Slow, calm, bedtime - long form only, never a short
content_types.story_cartoon: Original narrative cartoon, no rhyme required
